data.one_liner: Smartlook SDK wrapper for Flutter user behavior analysis.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the Smartlook analytics SDK to provide session recordings, automatic event tracking, conversion funnels, and user heatmaps for Android and iOS apps.
use_when: You need user session recordings and click heatmaps.
You want to automatically track app events and user behavior.
avoid_when: You only need simple app error logging or crash reporting without session replay.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms based on plugin configuration.
License is unknown from package metadata.
data.setup_notes: Requires implementation of native Smartlook API configuration as documented in the Smartlook API docs.
